meaning: Total frequency span of all bins within 3 dB of the global peak.
input_and_normalization: $Z$; $D_k$ compared with the global maximum of $D$.
calculation: For $S_3=\{k:D_k\geq\max_jD_j-3\}$, return $\max_{k\in S_3}f_k-\min_{k\in S_3}f_k$. Empty mask returns zero; one bin also gives zero. Range $[0,\,1-1/M]$.
scope: First 8192 samples; all FFT bins; before 16-bin pooling

meaning: Total frequency span of all bins within 10 dB of the global peak.

calculation: For $S_{10}=\{k:D_k\geq\max_jD_j-10\}$, return $\max_{k\in S_{10}}f_k-\min_{k\in S_{10}}f_k$, or zero for an empty mask. Range $[0,\,1-1/M]$.
scope: First 8192 samples; all FFT bins; before 16-bin pooling

meaning: Negative-frequency versus nonnegative-frequency power imbalance. Positive means the negative half has more power.
input_and_normalization: $Z$; sums of $P_k$ over the two FFT halves.
calculation: $10\log_{10}[(\sum_{k=0}^{M/2-1}P_k+\epsilon)/(\sum_{k=M/2}^{M-1}P_k+\epsilon)]$. DC belongs to the right half; the negative Nyquist bin belongs to the left. No fixed signal-independent finite bounds.
scope: First 8192 samples; all FFT bins; before 16-bin pooling

meaning: Geometric-to-arithmetic mean FFT-power ratio; values nearer zero indicate a flatter full-grid power distribution.
input_and_normalization: $Z$; all 8192 $P_k$, including out-of-band bins and the epsilon floor.
calculation: $10\log_{10}\{\exp[M^{-1}\sum_k\ln P_k]/[M^{-1}\sum_kP_k]\}$. Natural logarithm inside the geometric mean. Nonpositive mathematically, up to rounding; no fixed finite lower bound.
scope: First 8192 samples; all FFT bins; before 16-bin pooling

meaning: Full-grid spread of log FFT power. This is not a passband-only ripple or peak-to-peak ripple measure.
calculation: `np.std(D - np.mean(D))`, i.e. $\sqrt{M^{-1}\sum_k(D_k-\bar D)^2}$ with `ddof=0`. Nonnegative; no fixed finite upper bound. No fitted-envelope subtraction.
scope: First 8192 samples; all FFT bins; before 16-bin pooling
